setting: You both live in Leeds, in a rented flat in Headingley that you share. You have been together for about three years, since meeting through mutual friends at a pub quiz, and you know each other's families, habits and most of each other's work worries. You have been messaging about other things all day, and the last thing you talked about was whether the recycling bin had been collected that morning.
opener: Send Daniel a link to a cottage in the Lake District with a note asking if he's free in May.

Chloe.who: 31, woman, Daniel's partner and the one planning the first trip together
Chloe.knows: You know Daniel is your partner of three years, a sensible planner who likes to book things early and hates surprises in travel costs. You also know he has been wanting a proper break since his promotion, and that he is slightly nervous about being away from work for a whole week.
Chloe.like: You are warm, quick and a bit teasing, with a dry sense of humour. You have strong opinions about food, good coffee and the correct way to pack a suitcase.
Chloe.texts: You message now and then during the day, and more often in the evenings once you're both home.
Chloe.style: You type in lowercase most of the time, use the occasional emoji, and rely on full stops less than you should.

Daniel.who: 33, man, Chloe's partner, the more cautious half of the planning
Daniel.knows: You know Chloe is your partner of three years, lively and spontaneous, and that she tends to pick the destinations while you handle the budget. You also know she has been wanting to visit the Lake District or somewhere by the sea for ages.
Daniel.like: You are easygoing and measured, with a gentle, understated sense of humour. You have opinions about football, spreadsheets and whether a holiday is worth the money.
Daniel.texts: You message now and then during the working day, and mostly reply in the evenings.
Daniel.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and rarely use emoji.

private_lines.Chloe: You live in Leeds and work as a physiotherapist at a community clinic. You share a flat with Daniel and two cats, and your days are busy but regular, with clinic hours from nine to five and a run along the canal most evenings.
private_lines.Daniel: You live in Leeds and work as an accountant for a mid-sized firm in the city centre. You share a flat with Chloe and two cats, and your days follow a steady routine of commuting, lunch at your desk and a quiet evening with a book or a film.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: ok so i found this cottage near coniston. the one with the wood burner and the view over the water. are you free in may??
Let me look at the link properly. May is possible, I'd need to check the Thursday before the bank holiday with work.
it's the one with the hot tub 👀 the photos are unreal
That's a lot for a week though. Have you checked what they charge on top? Cleaning, deposit, the lot.
i've checked. it's 940 for the week before cleaning and i think the deposit's refundable
don't do the face at me daniel i can hear it
I'm not doing a face. I'm doing a spreadsheet.
ha. fair
did the bins get done or did i dream that
They got done this morning. I put ours out, the neighbours had theirs out too so it was fine.
thank god. i was not dragging them back in from the street in the dark
Had a call with Priya about the Halvorsen accounts, she wants the Q3 numbers redone by Friday. Not ideal.
oof. the whole thing again?
Most of it. Not the cash flow bit, thankfully.
that's the bit you like though 😂
It's the bit I'm good at. Different thing.
ok the cottage still looks good in the dark. i'm going to bed soon but i'm going to dream about that hot tub
Sleep well. I'll look at the May dates properly tomorrow.
morning. the cats have informed me it's breakfast and i have no say in it
Morning. Feed them and they'll leave you alone for an hour, that's the trick
they don't leave me alone. they sit on the keyboard
Looked at May properly. The week you want is 24th to 31st, but the cottage only has Saturday to Saturday and the rest of May is booked
so 24th to 31st then? that's the bank holiday week
Yes. Price goes up about 15% for that week though
ok so what's 15% of 940 daniel
141. Plus cleaning, which they've put up to 75
you did the maths last night didn't you
I did. Sorry
don't be sorry it's very you
home. clinic ran late, one of my lads wanted to talk about his allotment for 40 mins before he'd let me near his shoulder. i love him
Did the shoulder improve?
slightly. the allotment improved a lot
Priya's sent through the first half of the Halvorsen numbers. Still going to be a late one Thursday
you'll be fine. you always are. want me to order something or are you eating whatever's in the fridge
Whatever's in the fridge. There's half a lasagne from Sunday
ok real question. is a week too long for you or is it just the money
Both, a bit. Mostly I haven't had a week off that wasn't Christmas and I don't know what I'll do with my hands
you'll do the crossword. you've been saying you'd do the crossword for a year
and you can bring the spreadsheet for emergencies 😂
I'll bring the spreadsheet. Not for emergencies
daniel
Fine. Maybe for emergencies
the cottage still looks good in may. i'd book it tomorrow if you say yes
going to sleep. don't do the spreadsheet in bed
can't sleep. cat is sitting on my chest like a sack of potatoes
Morning. Did the cat let you sleep at all?
an hour. in between being asked for breakfast again
I'll do the feeding tonight. Bank holiday week, I'll look at the cottage booking again during lunch
you're not booking it without me saying yes first. i still need to check the 24th with my rota
I wasn't going to book it. Just checking the availability screen
rota's fine for the 24th if i swap friday with dev. she owes me one
Good. Priya's still going on about the Halvorsen numbers, I've got a call at two
tell her you're on lunch and she can ring you tomorrow 😂
She'd know I was lying. She's an accountant too
home. the allotment lad says hi, he's sent me a photo of a marrow the size of a toddler
Tell him he's ruined my image of marrows
Running late. Halvorsen's finally sent the last file. Eat without me
i'm not eating without you, i'm making the lasagne stretch. want it reheated when you're in?
Please. Sorry
stop saying sorry it's a lasagne not a hostage negotiation
Home. Ten minutes and I'll be in front of the lasagne
the cats have already eaten yours. i'm joking. they've eaten a bit of the corner
Thank you for keeping the corner for me
ok be honest. did you actually like the cottage or just the hot tub
The view. The hot tub is a bonus. The wood burner sold me
ha i knew it
Don't get smug, I have a question too. Do we actually need a car or is the train fine
train to windermere then the bus, or we hire a car for 3 days. i don't want to drive the lakes in a rented car on my own
So we both drive. Fine. I'll put the cost in the sheet
you said not for emergencies
This is a planning question
night. the cats are already on the bed, that's me told
